en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 7. Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Shaybani (ra) said: Muhammad ibn Abu `Abd Allah al-Kufi said, that Musa ibn `Imran al-Nakha’i on the authority of his uncle al-Husayn ibn Yazid al-Nawfali on the authority of `Ali ibn Salim, Abu `Abdillah (AS) said:
“Verily, Allah, Blessed and Exalted be He, has forbidden Hellfire to the bodies of the monotheists.”
